title: Lovely Sour Venezuelan Potato Empanadas
description: A festive Venezuelan dish featuring russet potato and miso marinate, perfect for a plant-based friendly meal. This recipe combines the flavors of sour and bouncy textures.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the diced potatoes, miso paste, olive oil, onion, and garlic.
Let the mixture marinate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to combine.
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Spoon about 1 tablespoon of the potato mixture onto the center of each empanada dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little bit of olive oil.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the empanadas from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the empanadas warm with a squeeze of lime juice and a sprinkle of salt.
